result.title: Beyond Single-Attribute Auditing: A Configurable Multi-Attribute Benchmark for Intersectional Fairness in LLMs
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated for fairness, yet most existing benchmarks audit one sensitive attribute at a time. This single-attribute paradigm can miss intersectional harms, where multiple attributes interact non-additively and produce failures that are invisible under marginal evaluation. We introduce ComFair, a configurable benchmark that converts existing fairness data into 479,066 controlled Dual- and Multi-attribute instances and pairs every augmented instance with its task-equivalent source. Across Recognition, Selection, Continuation, and Conversation, this pairing supports a unified audit of performance or bias-score shifts, how often added attributes introduce new errors or mask existing ones, and model-ranking stability. Experiments on ten LLMs show task- and subgroup-dependent sensitivity: discriminative tasks expose both transition directions even when aggregate changes are modest, generative tasks exhibit larger and directionally asymmetric shifts, and rankings vary with attribute composition. ComFair therefore provides a scalable controlled sensitivity audit---rather than a model of the natural joint distribution of identities---for testing the robustness of fairness-benchmark conclusions beyond single-attribute settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ComFair，一个可配置的多属性交叉公平性基准，将既有公平数据构造为 47 万余条双属性/多属性受控实例，并与同任务的单属性源实例配对，用于审计性能与偏见分数的变化及模型排序稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是纯文本 LLM 公平性评测，关注敏感属性组合下的偏见转移与排序稳定性，不涉及视觉或多模态推理、内部状态表示、latent 生成或证据筛选，也无可借用的状态更新与监督线索。
